description: Whispering Web support locations and the Gambler's Folly artifact.

entries.title: Whispering Web Relay Hubs
entries.summary: Specialized towers and bastions sustain long-distance communication across mountains, forests, coasts, volcanoes, and underground routes.
body: Five prominent support structures adapt the [[world-whispering-web|World Whispering Web]] to difficult terrain: the high-mountain Skyward Spire, forested Verdant Nexus, coastal Azure Watchtower, volcanic Emberforge Bastion, and subterranean Shadowspire Crypt.
Each hub combines communication infrastructure with local defenses, operators, maintenance needs, and environmental risks, making it both a strategic asset and an adventure location.

entries.title: The Gambler's Folly
entries.summary: A supernatural deck offers reality-altering fortune and catastrophe while causing drawn cards to vanish from the world.
body: The Gambler's Folly is surrounded by contradictory ownership stories and warnings. Drawing from it can grant extraordinary benefit or inflict ruin, and the deck resists predictable exploitation.

Its defining mystery is disappearance: cards vanish after use, changing the surviving deck and making every recorded encounter uncertain. Seekers debate whether the deck tests greed, serves an unknown intelligence, or simply embodies chance.

sections.heading: Legacy Card Resolution
body: The source supplies separate harmful Folly and beneficial Fool card results with fifth-edition effects. All card mechanics require conversion before rules-facing use.
